GenericTalentRewind.name: Rewind
GenericTalentRewind.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

MuradinDwarfBlock.name: Dwarf Block
MuradinDwarfBlock.description: Casting Dwarf Toss grants 3 charges of Block. Each Block charge grants 75 Physical Armor against a single enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

MuradinCombatStyleThirdWind.name: Third Wind
MuradinCombatStyleThirdWind.description: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 per second Restoration.

MuradinGiveEmTheAxeExecutioner60DamageBo.name: Give 'em the Axe!
MuradinGiveEmTheAxeExecutioner60DamageBo.description: Attacking a Hero that is Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed increases Muradin's Basic Attack damage by 40% for 3 seconds.

MuradinMasteryStormhammerSledgehammer.name: Sledgehammer
MuradinMasteryStormhammerSledgehammer.description: Storm Bolt deals 500% damage to non-Heroic enemies. Stormbolt cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

MuradinMasteryThunderclapReverberation.name: Reverberation
MuradinMasteryThunderclapReverberation.description: Increases the Attack Speed Slow of Thunder Clap from 30% to 50% and the duration from 2.5 seconds to 3.5 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

MuradinMasteryThunderburn.name: Thunder Burn
MuradinMasteryThunderburn.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Thunder Clap triggers a second Thunder Clap explosion 2 seconds later in the same location that deals 72 damage.

MuradinStormboltPerfectStorm.name: Perfect Storm
MuradinStormboltPerfectStorm.description: Storm Bolt's cooldown is reset and 25 Mana is refunded if an enemy dies within 3 seconds of being hit by it. This effect has an 8.5 second cooldown.

MuradinMasteryDwarfTossHeavyImpact.name: Heavy Impact
MuradinMasteryDwarfTossHeavyImpact.description: Enemies hit by Dwarf Toss are Slowed by 80% for 1.5 seconds.

MuradinCombatStyleSkullcracker.name: Skullcracker
MuradinCombatStyleSkullcracker.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same enemy deals 90% bonus damage and Stuns them for 0.25 seconds.

MuradinHeroicAbilityHaymaker.name: Haymaker
MuradinHeroicAbilityHaymaker.description: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319 damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319 damage and knocking them aside.

MuradinBronzebeardRage.name: Bronzebeard Rage
MuradinBronzebeardRage.description: Deal 15 damage per second to nearby enemies and heal for 75% of the damage dealt. Hitting an enemy Hero with Storm Bolt increase this damage by 200% for 3 seconds.

MuradinMasteryThunderclapHealingStatic.name: Healing Static
MuradinMasteryThunderclapHealingStatic.description: Muradin heals for 6% of his maximum Health for each Hero hit by Thunder Clap.

MuradinMasteryThunderclapThunderstrike.name: Thunder Strike
MuradinMasteryThunderclapThunderstrike.description: Thunder Clap deals 200% more damage if only one target is hit. Passive: Increase the duration of Dwarf Toss's Armor by 2 seconds.

MuradinMasteryDwarfTossDwarfLaunch.name: Dwarf Launch
MuradinMasteryDwarfTossDwarfLaunch.description: Increase the range of Dwarf Toss by 30%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Dwarf Toss reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

MuradinMasteryPassiveStoneform.name: Stoneform
MuradinMasteryPassiveStoneform.description: Activate to heal Muradin for 30% of his maximum Health over 10 seconds. Second Wind is disabled during this time.

GenericTalentImposingPresence.name: Imposing Presence
GenericTalentImposingPresence.description: Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds. Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

MuradinMasteryAvatarUnstoppableForce.name: Unstoppable Force
MuradinMasteryAvatarUnstoppableForce.description: While active, Avatar grants 20 Armor and causes Muradin's Basic Attacks to reduce the cooldowns of Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss by 0.75 seconds.

MuradinMasteryHaymakerGrandSlam.name: Grand Slam
MuradinMasteryHaymakerGrandSlam.description: Haymaker gains a 2nd charge and its damage is increased by 25%. If a Hero dies within 3 seconds of being hit by Haymaker, instantly gain 1 charge.

MuradinExtraCharges.name: Mountain King
MuradinExtraCharges.description: Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss each gain a 2nd charge.

GenericTalentHardenedShield.name: Hardened Shield
GenericTalentHardenedShield.description: Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 75% less damage.
